div.p: The world is at war and on the brink of utter destruction.
It is an hour for Might and an hour for Magic.
It is a time for Heroes to save the world from Chaos.
Your ancestors were strong and fearless…
We came to them with a promise, and they answered Asha’s calling.
To restore Order to our ravaged world…
This was their quest… and it has fallen to you.
Their triumphs brought the return of Sylanna… the goddess of Earth.
The fight continued for decades and courage was rewarded.
Ylath, the Dragon God of Air appeared… unearthing the Fortresses of the Dwarves…
…and the memory of their forgotten lore.
The Dwarves are divided, and your mission is to unite them under one banner.
Arkath, the Dragon God of Fire, and patron to the Dwarves still sleeps… waiting for them to call him back into existence.
But another race has also escaped from the undergrounds… a bitter enemy who stalks in the shadows…
…waiting for the right moment to make themselves known.
